title: Senior Machine Learning Software Engineer — Embedded & Edge AI
description: **Work arrangement:** hybrid, based in Bologna, Italy. - **Start date:** as soon as possible.   ### Bring machine learning into real-world systems   At **NAIS** , a University of Bologna spin-off, we tackle industrial problems where applied research, software and hardware need to work together. Our projects span computer vision, signals and time series, anomaly detection, calibration and virtual sensors, with applications on edge devices and embedded platforms.   We are looking for a **Senior Machine Learning Software Engineer** to take technical ownership of our solutions, from experimentation to release: develop and validate models, build the software that integrates them and evolve it over time.   ### How we work   In research and exploratory analysis, we use short iterations to test assumptions and change direction based on results. In product software, we invest in architecture, testing, documentation and maintainability. We value the engineering judgement to choose the right level of structure and depth for the objective, project stage and risks involved.   ### Your impact   - Design and evolve software systems in **Python and C++** that integrate ML models, tools and services, taking care of architecture, interfaces and maintainability. - Develop, adapt and validate models and algorithms, taking care of data, preprocessing, metrics and reproducibility. - Export and integrate models into inference runtimes, connect them to sensors and application logic, and verify their behaviour on the target system. - Measure and improve accuracy, latency, throughput and memory usage on target devices. - Take responsibility for testing, builds, packaging and releases, and contribute to troubleshooting and maintenance. - Collaborate with software, hardware and domain specialists, document decisions and support the team’s technical growth.   ### What you bring   - A **Master’s degree** in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related field. - Experience delivering ML solutions to production and maintaining software systems over time, with technical ownership of the outcome. - Strong **Python** skills and the ability to develop and debug **C++** independently. - Solid **applied machine learning** foundations: data quality, training, evaluation, generalisation and error analysis. - Hands-on experience with **PyTorch** or equivalent frameworks, and willingness to work with our existing PyTorch pipelines. - Experience exporting and integrating models into inference runtimes, preferably through **ONNX** . - Familiarity with **Linux** , Git, automated testing, build tools and profiling. - Experience with **AI coding assistants** — Codex, Claude or equivalent tools of your choice — with the ability to guide their use, understand, critically review and verify the resulting code, and retain full technical ownership. - Substantial experience in computer vision or signal and time-series analysis, with an interest in working across both areas. - Independence, sound prioritisation and the ability to communicate results, constraints and technical decisions.   ### Skills we would also value   - **OpenVINO** , **YOLO/Ultralytics** , ONNX Runtime, OpenCV and TensorFlow/Keras. - Embedded systems, ARM/AArch64, cross-compilation and CMake. - Multichannel signal processing, time-frequency analysis, calibration and virtual sensors. - Quantisation, reduced precision, distillation and inference optimisation. - Integration on electronic control units or microcontrollers, including timing and memory constraints. - MLflow, DVC and traceability across datasets, experiments and models. - A **PhD** in a field relevant to the role.   ### Why NAIS   We are a young, energetic and dynamic company based in Bologna, in the heart of **Italy’s Motor Valley** . Here, applied research and industry come together to tackle advanced engineering challenges. You will help shape technical decisions, follow solutions through to real-world use and see the impact of your work.   We believe in a meritocratic culture that values skills, initiative and tangible contributions. We encourage open discussion and knowledge sharing, and see professional growth as closely connected to strong working relationships. We are looking for people who want to take responsibility and build alongside the team.   **Does this sound like you?** Tell us about a project you took from model to application: the decisions you made, the constraints you faced and what you learned.   **Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.** If you believe you can take on these challenges, show initiative and take ownership of your work, we would like to hear from you.
